messages:
elaine: Heads up — the Python starter samples on the docs site have a couple of issues I hit while onboarding a new hire today. The embed image in README 404s and the async example's typing doesn't match the SDK, causing mypy failures.

sam: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the exact links/snippets you hit?

elaine: Sure. From the sample repo README: 
```
from redwood import AsyncClient
client: AsyncClient = AsyncClient()  # mypy: error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type 'AsyncClient', variable has type 'AsyncClient')
await client.generate("hello")
```
The image link in the README header points to https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redwood-inference/samples/main/assets/hero.png which returns 404.

jordan: That code block looks like the typed annotation is redundant but weird — are we sure the stub in the SDK defines AsyncClient differently? Could be a typing-only regression from the refactor last month. :eyes:

mike: I think CI stopped publishing the "assets" directory after we moved the sample repo to the monorepo. Build logs show the upload step skipped because of a path change in scripts/publish_samples.sh. I filed a quick ticket: https://redwood-internal/issue/5642

docs-bot: Created issue #5643: "docs: fix broken sample asset links and async typing mismatch in Python starter" (assigned to @jordan).

jordan: I'll take the docs side. Quick plan: (1) update README with new asset path under /static/samples/hero.png, (2) remove the explicit typed assignment in the async example and make it `client = AsyncClient()` so mypy doesn't choke, (3) add a test that renders the README to catch 404s.

sam: Sounds good. Is the typing problem a public API change though? If the AsyncClient signature changed, we might need a minor SDK patch so samples and stable users don't get broken.

jordan: I traced it — the runtime class is the same, but we switched to a protocol for AsyncClient in typing stubs which makes `client: AsyncClient = AsyncClient()` ambiguous. Fix options: change stub to a concrete class or update sample to avoid explicit annotation. Prefer the latter for now.

elaine: For the onboarding flow I'd prefer the sample reflect recommended usage, i.e., `client = AsyncClient()` and add a short note about typing when using mypy. That should be low risk.

mike: I'll update the publish script in a small PR to push assets to the right bucket. Once that's in, we should backfill the tests.

docs-bot: PR opened: https://redwood-internal/pull/1209 by jordan - "fix(python-samples): update asset path and async example typing" :thumbsup:

sam: Great — can we also add a quick CI job that runs `python -m http.server` and tries to fetch README assets? Simple link-check will prevent regressions.

jordan: Adding that to the sample repo CI now. I'll also add a short note in the SDK changelog about typing stubs for anyone relying on strict annotations.

elaine: Thanks y'all. This caused an awkward 20m stop-start during onboarding so happy to see a quick fix. :relieved:

mike: deployed fix for publish scripts, assets are live. :shipit:

docs-bot: Issue #5643 closed by jordan via PR 1209.

elaine: Closing this thread — reached out to the new hire to confirm the sample now works. All good on my side.
